table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Category=CC.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	InvoiceNo=S.SaleInvCode, 
	InvTotal = S.InvTotal,
	OutStandingAmt=S.OutStandingAmt, 
	InvoiceAge=DATEDIFF(day, S.date, GETDATE()), 
	LowerLimit = (SELECT MAX(AID.Limit) 
		FROM AgingIntervalDetail AID
		WHERE AID.AgingIntervalCode=:ai_aginginterval AND DATEDIFF(day, S.date, GETDATE()) >= limit),
	UpperLimit=
		(SELECT MIN(AID2.Limit) - 1
		FROM AgingIntervalDetail AID2
		WHERE AID2.AgingIntervalCode=:ai_aginginterval AND AID2.LIMIT >
			(SELECT L=MAX(AID.Limit) 
			FROM AgingIntervalDetail AID
			WHERE AID.AgingIntervalCode=:ai_aginginterval AND DATEDIFF(day, S.date, GETDATE()) >= limit))
FROM 
	SaleLedger S, Customer C, CustomerCategory CC, Accounts A
WHERE
	S.SaleCatCode IN (2) AND S.Posted='Y' AND S.Marked ='N' AND 
	S.CustCode=C.CustCode AND C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	C.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	DATEDIFF(day, S.date, GETDATE()) BETWEEN :ai_from_interval AND :ai_to_interval
table.sort: category A, customer A, invoiceage D, invoiceno A

objects.name: t_1
objects.text: Customer Aging Analysis Detail - Invoice Based

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: IF(ISNULL(upperlimit), '>=', '') + trim( string( lowerlimit ) ) + IF(ISNULL(upperlimit), '', ' - ' + trim( string( upperlimit )))
